tenant_overview.note: Every value in the report comes from one of these calls, run exactly as written with the params filled in. Everything works from one collection run, as on a prospect's first pull: aggregates, the latest Microsoft Secure Score snapshot (secure_score, no filter), the Secure Score recommended actions below their maximum points, and three lists for the high-impact section. A list longer than its maxResults is paged with pageToken and saved as one input; the build fails if a list was cut short. maxBuckets and maxResults values are unique per call so the echo in each response identifies it.

identity_deep_dive.note: Every value in the report comes from one of these calls, run exactly as written with the params filled in. A list returns at most maxResults rows a page: call query again with pageToken set to the previous response's nextPageToken until none comes back. The build fails if a list holds fewer rows than its totalCount. maxBuckets and maxResults values are unique per call so the echo in each response identifies it. Every call reads the latest collection run alone: nothing depends on history kept across runs.

devices_deep_dive.note: Every value in the report comes from one of these calls, run exactly as written with the params filled in. A list longer than its maxResults is paged with pageToken and saved as one input; the build fails if a list was cut short. Every call reads one collection run; nothing needs history across runs.

entra_apps_deep_dive.note: Every value in the report comes from one of these calls, run exactly as written with the params filled in. Lists are read at most 100 rows a page and every page is saved; the build fails if a list was cut short. Microsoft-published: appOwnerOrganizationId is one of the seven Microsoft tenant ids in references/app-classification-convention.md; the grammar has no notIn, so the lists AND seven ne filters, which keep apps with no appOwnerOrganizationId. Application permissions come from each API's appRoleAssignedTo, because an app's own appRoleAssignments list stops at 20 (I365-562) and its stored permissionValue labels are unreliable. Secure Score controls in scope: App Governance (AppG) and Defender for Cloud Apps (MCAS), plus the Entra ID controls IntegratedApps, aad_admin_consent_workflow and aad_third_party_apps. Single ingest: every date is one Microsoft returns on the object (createdDateTime on the service principal and on each app role assignment, credential start and end dates) or in its sign-in activity report (lastSignInDateTime). lastConsentDateTime is not read: the Collector takes it from audit log consent events in the 30 days before a run, and Entra keeps 7 days of audit log without P1 or P2.

installed_software_deep_dive.note: Every value in the report comes from one of these calls, run exactly as written with the params filled in, one at a time. Lists are paged until no nextPageToken comes back; the saver joins the pages. maxBuckets and maxResults values are unique per call so the echo in each response identifies it.

collaboration_deep_dive.note: Every value in the report comes from one of these calls, run exactly as written with the params filled in. maxBuckets and maxResults values are unique per call so the echo in each response identifies it. Lists hold up to 100 rows a page; a longer list is fetched page by page with pageToken and saved as one input, and the build fails if a list is short. Every call reads one collection run: nothing needs history from earlier runs.

app_access.note: Every value in the report comes from one of these calls, run exactly as written with the params filled in. api_assignments, delegated_grants and role_apps are the same calls as the mailbox access recipe's, apps_by_category the assessment report's, so a run on the same day can reuse their saved responses. maxResults and maxBuckets values are unique per call.

selftest.about: The self-test's live calls. build.py merges them into the package's recipes.json under selftest; selftest.py plans and checks them. The first is the tenant overview's first call, the one Cowork failed on with plugin 0.5.1.
